--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,41 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validate inputs
+    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
+        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-empty")
+        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
+        if (arr > 0).any():
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
+    # Check shape consistency
+    n_candidates = logp_with_result.shape[0]
+    future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape[1]
+    if logp_call_only.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon):
+        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
+    if logp_no_call.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon):
+        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
+    # Validate tau_filter
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric scalar")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
+
+    # Compute margins according to Toolformer loss filter:
+    # margin = sum(logp_with_result) - max(sum(logp_no_call), sum(logp_call_only))
+    sum_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
+    sum_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
+    sum_no_call = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
+    margins = sum_with - np.minimum(sum_call, sum_no_call)
+
+    keep = margins > tau_filter
+    return keep, margins
